notable_absence.finding: No edition badge, storage-engine mention, or server-version-string citation on this page - both known recurring anomalies absent, as expected for a UI-procedure page about a Data Tools feature that is storage-engine- and edition-agnostic.

cross_component_finding: Single-role gate (Data Writer only) for the entire import feature, whether importing from the browser, generating a `cbimport` command, or loading sample data - no distinction between these three import paths in terms of role requirement. This is a clean, minimal instance of the batch's data-access role family (Data Reader/Data Writer), contrasted with data-service.md's separate administration role family (Project Owner/Cluster Manager) for bucket/scope/collection creation - import is classified as a data-write operation on an existing bucket/scope/collection, not an administrative one.
